# Assessment Overview

This directory contains the supplementary assessment documents copied from `.github/modernize/assessment/engines` for the current report.

## Available Documents

- [`architecture-diagram.md`](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component interaction diagrams.
- [`dependency-map.md`](./dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [`api-service-contracts.md`](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, contracts, and communication sequence.
- [`data-architecture.md`](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity relationships, and persistence-layer analysis.
- [`configuration-inventory.md`](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [`business-workflows.md`](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows, domain mapping, and workflow sequence.
